lines.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David.
Save me, O God,
for the waters are up to my neck.
I have sunk into the miry depths,
where there is no footing;
I have drifted into deep waters,
where the flood engulfs me.
I am weary from my crying;
my throat is parched.
My eyes fail,
looking for my God.
Those who hate me without cause
outnumber the hairs of my head;
many are those who would destroy me—
my enemies for no reason.
Though I did not steal,
I must repay.
You know my folly, O God,
and my guilt is not hidden from You.
May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me,
O Lord GOD of Hosts;
may those who seek You not be dishonored through me,
O God of Israel.

pictures.scene: Jan Porcellis, Vissersboten in onrustig water - small fishing boats heeling over in a grey choppy sea with the spray breaking across them, the opening cry Save me, O God
pictures.name: pd_porcellis_vissersboten_in_onrustig_water

pictures.scene: Fyodor Vasilyev, Dooi - a thaw turning the road to black water and mud with two small travellers wading out into it, the waters up to my neck and the sinking into the miry depths
pictures.name: pd_vasilyev_dooi

pictures.scene: Mihaly Munkacsy, Vrouw met takkenbos - a woman labouring over broken ground under her heavy bundle of sticks with nothing firm under her feet, where there is no footing and the drift into deep waters
pictures.name: pd_munkacsy_vrouw_met_takkenbos

pictures.scene: Francis Danby, Bergstroom - a mountain torrent pouring white down the rocks and filling the whole gorge, where the flood engulfs me and I am weary from my crying
pictures.name: pd_danby_bergstroom

pictures.scene: Carlos de Haes, Boerderij bij Elche - a baked dry farmstead under a hard pale sky with the ground cracked and colourless, my throat is parched and my eyes fail
pictures.name: pd_de_haes_boerderij_bij_elche

pictures.scene: Jan van Huchtenburgh, Dobbelspel om het leven - armed men crowding round a table to throw dice for a man's life, those who hate me without cause
pictures.name: pd_huchtenburgh_dobbelspel_om_het_leven

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, Hallali van het hert - the whole pack closing on the cornered stag in the snow, many are those who would destroy me
pictures.name: pd_courbet_hallali_van_het_hert

pictures.scene: Jan van Hemessen, De onbarmhartige dienstknecht - the servant seized by the throat over a debt at the money table, though I did not steal, I must repay
pictures.name: pd_hemessen_onbarmhartige_dienstknecht

pictures.scene: Jan Lievens, Het feestmaal van Esther - the hidden thing spoken out at the king's table and the guilty man exposed, You know my folly and my guilt is not hidden from You
pictures.name: pd_lievens_het_feestmaal_van_esther

pictures.scene: Friedrich Wilhelm Schadow, De wijze maagden - the waiting maidens with their lamps still burning and their faces lifted, may those who hope in You not be ashamed through me
pictures.name: pd_schadow_de_wijze_maagden

pictures.scene: Eugene Burnand, Hogepriesterlijk gebed - Christ at prayer with His face raised in the dark, the appeal to the Lord GOD of Hosts for all who seek Him
pictures.name: pd_burnand_hogepriesterlijk_gebed

pictures.scene: Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, Wekenfeest - a household of Israel keeping the feast together in their own room, O God of Israel, for I have endured scorn for Your sake
pictures.name: pd_oppenheim_wekenfeest
